ja324:1.1: Kalyāṇarūpo vatāyaṃ catuppado subhaddako c' eva supesalo ca yo brāhmanaṃ jātimantūpapannaṃ apacāyati meṇḍavaro yasassīti.
ja324:2.1: Mā brāhmaṇa ittaradassanena vissāsam āpajji catuppadassa, daḷhappahāraṃ abhikaṃkhamāno avasakkatī dassati suppahāran
ja324:3.1: ti. Satthi bhaggā, pavaṭṭito khāribhāro, sabbaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ brāhmaṇass' īdha bhinnaṃ, bāhā paggayha kandati: abhidhāvatha, haññate brahmacārīti.
ja324:4.1: Evaṃ so nihato seti yo apūjaṃ namassati yathāham ajja pahato hato meṇḍena dummatīti.
